claims.evidence: Photos 0-2 show a flanged gear unit matching a speed reducer/gearbox shape with input/output shaft and base plate.
No nameplate, data plate, or stamped power rating is visible in any photo; this capacity cannot be confirmed from the images alone.
Housing shape and paint finish are consistent with a cast metal gearbox body, but material composition cannot be confirmed visually with certainty.

risks.risk: No manufacturer nameplate or model number visible, so true power/ratio/brand is unknown.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of any stamped or riveted nameplate/data plate on the housing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unbranded, unrated generic reducer at the lowest matching worst-case tier.

risks.risk: Internal gear and bearing condition cannot be assessed from static photos; could be worn, cracked, or seized.
risks.proof: Video clip of the shaft being turned by hand or under power showing smooth rotation without excessive play or noise.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-functional / for-parts condition until motion is demonstrated.

risks.risk: Oil/lubricant condition and seal integrity unknown; leaks or dry-run damage possible.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of oil fill/drain plug area and any seal surfaces showing no leakage or residue.
risks.if_unproven: Price as requiring service/reseal before use.

risks.risk: Shaft dimensions, keyway, and mounting bolt pattern may not match buyer's application.
risks.proof: Photo with a tape measure against shaft diameter, keyway width, and base plate bolt spacing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unconfirmed-fit, buyer assumes compatibility risk.

risks.risk: Age and hours of use are unknown, affecting remaining service life.
risks.proof: Any service record, purchase receipt, or visible wear marks photographed close-up.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used/well-worn industrial equipment, not new or lightly used.

proof_requests: Close-up of any nameplate or stamped markings on the housing
Video of the shaft rotating freely by hand or under load
Photo of oil fill/drain area and seals for leakage signs
Tape-measure photo of shaft diameter, keyway, and bolt pattern
Any documentation of age, usage hours, or service history
response.reason: The witness confirms this is an industrial gearbox/speed reducer, so it can be priced at worst case given the unverifiable power rating and unknown internal condition, pending nameplate and function proof.
